comment: Takeoff - risers and downlifters that only add sound on top (the input passes through untouched, stereo). Sounds NOISE (white noise through a resonant sweeping filter), SAW (3 detuned saws spread left and right), SINE, N+SAW, N+SIN. Volume swells with the sweep, width grows, exponential curve. Dir UP sweeps up and cuts clean at the end, DOWN starts at the top and falls and fades. Space = reverb tail on the riser's own sound. Key AUTO listens to the input and starts and ends the sweep on its strongest note (FREE when there is no clear note). Trig PLAY: any on/off flip fires a timed sweep over Len, a flip during a sweep drops it, and holding the footswitch (needs the MOD firmware) rises while held and drops on release. MAN: Pos is the position.
gid_comment: 0x08 = Delay category -> Fx_DLY_. Grouped under DLY with the rest of the pack.
fxid_comment: 480 DualShft, 481 LOUDER, 484 DJFilter, 485 DubSiren, 486 Choral, 487 WaveFold, 488 EuGate, 489 S.GN_L, 490 Scrub, 491 DirtBox, 492 Washout, 493 Breather, 494 Takeoff, 495 GRDELAY, 496 Sweep, 497 Looper (this pack; 494 was the dropped SyncEQ, 498-500 are probes). Not checked against the stock ZDLs on this PC (none present): run build/extract_effect_db.py with stock_zdls/ to confirm.

params.name: Dir
params.comment: 0 UP: sweeps up and cuts clean at the end (the drop). 1 DOWN: starts at the top, falls and fades to silence. Default UP.

params.name: Len
params.comment: Sweep length. 0..4 = 1, 2, 4, 8, 16 bars at the pedal's tempo (MIDI clock, tap or patch). 5..35 = FREE, 1..31 seconds. Default 2 = 4 bars.

params.name: Trig
params.comment: 0 PLAY: any on/off flip starts a timed sweep, a flip during a sweep drops it early, holding the footswitch (still down after 0.5 s, MOD firmware) rises while held and drops on release. 1 MAN: no automatic sweep, Pos is the position. Default PLAY.

params.name: Sound
params.comment: 0 NOISE, 1 SAW (3 detuned saws spread left and right), 2 N+SAW, 3 SINE (with DOWN and a low Range: the sub drop), 4 N+SIN. Default NOISE.

params.name: Key
params.comment: 0 AUTO: the strongest note of the input over the last few bars, the sweep starts and ends on it; no clear note = FREE. 1 FREE: untuned glide. 2..13 = C..B fixed. The listener runs only in AUTO. Default AUTO.

params.name: Space
params.comment: Reverb tail on the riser's own sound only, ringing on after the cut. 0 = off. Default 0.

params.name: Pos
params.comment: Manual position 0 (rest) to 100 (top), used only with Trig MAN. Smoothed. Default 0.

params.name: Vol
params.comment: Level of the added sound (linear). The input is never changed. Default 50.

audio_nop_comment: Set true for a UI-only smoke build before trusting the DSP.
dsp_cost_comment: Estimate (spec: 12-15 while sounding plus 3-5 for the AUTO key listener; this is the AUTO total). Idle costs next to nothing except the listener. Re-measure on the pedal.
